negative in that stretch was measured on data that could not answer the question.

E7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
978 genes, not a transcriptome. Landmarks were chosen to span expression space for
imputation, not to cover biology evenly, so a knockdown whose real effect misses
all 978 reads as no effect.
shRNA carries seed-based off-target effects: a signature is partly the intended
knockdown and partly the construct, which inflates gene-specificity and helps A1.
Nine cancer lines from one platform in one facility. Cross-context here means
across cancer lines, not across tissues or organisms.
Level 5 is z-scored against a plate population, so a response common to every
perturbation on a plate is already removed. That biases AGAINST A2_LINEMEAN by
construction and its score must be read with that in mind.
